chunks: And from a sermon of him (peace be upon him) in which he mentions the wonderful creation of the bat.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the creation of the bat in his sermons?
ai.summary: In this sermon from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) utilizes the bat (*bat*) as a profound example of *badi' al-khalq* (wonderful creation), illustrating how even creatures often overlooked by humans possess intricate divine design. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on observing nature (*ni'mah*) as a pathway to recognizing the Creator's omnipotence and wisdom, reinforcing the concept that all beings, regardless of their perceived insignificance, serve as signs (*ayat*) of God's power.
